introduction: This film is about the story of two young people who have just graduated from school. Zhang Yuan stayed in Changsha as a newspaper editor for the girl he loves. Dong Zhiqi stayed in Changsha as a trainee journalist for his reporter's dream. Zhang often thinks of Liu in the nine to five life. In love without hope, he picked up a childhood hobby - collecting stamps. Dong is actively in making a negative news, but was stopped by the editor when it was about to finish. Because of the gap between reality and ideal, he chose to resign and return to hometown. Finally, Zhang saw Dong off, while he stayed for the hopeless love.
